query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有危险及时通知我，情况有变化也请告诉我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child, notify me immediately if there is any danger, and also let me know if the situation changes.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝从垫子边缘摔下了，请尽快查看！
annotation.text_en: The baby has fallen from the edge of the mat. Please check on the baby immediately!

annotation.text_zh: 看护人已经赶来，正走向宝宝。
annotation.text_en: The caregiver has returned and is approaching the baby.

annotation.text_zh: 看护人正在俯身查看并照顾宝宝。
annotation.text_en: The caregiver is bending down to check on and care for the baby.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
